verses.en: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ona aau atu lea nisi e le tupu, ona latou faapotopoto ai lea ia te ia o toeaina uma o luta atoa ma lerusalema.

verses.en: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: ona faitau atu lea e ia, o latou o faalogologo ai, i upu uma lava o le tusi o le feagaiga na maua i le fale o Ieova.

verses.en: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
verses.sm: Ua tu foi le tupu i le tulaga ma osi ai le feagaiga i luma o ieova, e mulimuli atu ia Ieova, ma anaana i ana poloaiga, ma aua tulafono, atoa ma ana sauniga, i le loto atoa ma le agaga atoa, e faamauina foi upu o lenei feagaiga ua tusia i lenei tusi. Ua auga foi i le nuu uma le feagaiga.

verses.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o le tupu ia Hilikia le ositaulaga sili, ma ositaulaga e aupito ane ia te ia, atoa ma leoleo o le faitotoa, e au mai i fafo i le malumalu o Ieova o ipu uma na faia mo Paala, ma Asaira, ma ‘au uma a le lagi; ua ia susunu ai foi i tua o lerusalema i le fanua o Ketarono, ona ave ai lea o latou lefulefu i Peteli.

verses.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
verses.sm: Ua ia aveeseina foi le au faitaulaga e na faatuina e tupu o Iuta e faamu mea manogi i mea maualuluga i aai o Iuta, atoa ma mea e vagavagai i lerusalema; o i latou foi e na faamu mea manogi ia Paala, ma le la, ma le masina, ma faailoga o le lagi, atoa ma ‘au uma a le lagi,

verses.en: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.
verses.sm: Ua ia au mai foi le tupua o Asaira nai le fale o Ieova, ua ave i tua o Ierusalema i le alia o Ketarono, ua susunu ai i le alia o Ketarono, ma na tu‘ililiia pei o le efuefu, ona lafo ai lea o lona efuefu i luga o tuugamau o tagata o le nuu.

verses.en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.
verses.sm: Ua ia lepeti foi l fale o e faasotoma sa i tafatafa o le fale o ieova, na lalaga ai e fafine o fale ino Asaira i lea mea,

verses.en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.
verses.sm: Ua ia au mai foi ositaulaga uma na i aai o Iuta, ma na faa- Leaga i mea maualuluga na faamu ai mea manogi e le au ositaulaga, pau mai i Kipea pau mai i Peresepa, ma na lepeti foi i mea maualuluga o faitotoa sa i le mea e ui atu ai i le faitotoa o losua le alii e pule i le aai, sa i ai i le itu tauagavale o le tagata i le faitotoa ō le aai.

verses.en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
verses.sm: A e peitai e lei o ae ositaulaga o mea maualuluga i le fata faitam latou aai i lp areto le faafefeteina faatasi ma o latou uso.

verses.en: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
verses.sm: Ua ia faaleaga foi i Tofeta. o i le vanu o le atalii o Hinoma, ina ne‘i faaui ane e se tagata i lona atalii po o lona afafine i le afi ia Moloka.

verses.en: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.sm: Ua ia ave ese foi i solofanua na tuuina e tupu o Iuta mo le la i le faitotoa o le fale o ieova, e lata ane i le afeafe o Natana-meleka le auauna sili sa i Parevara, ma na susunu nofoa faataavalevale o le la i le afi.

verses.en: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
verses.sm: Ua lepeti foi e le tupu o fata faitaulaga na i luga o le afeafe aupitoaluga o Aasa na faia. e tupu o Iuta, atoa ma fata faitaulaga na faia e Manase i lotoā uma e lua o le fale o Ieova, ona tele vave atu ai lea nai lea mea, ma Sasaa atu o latou efuefu i le alia o Ketarono.

verses.en: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
verses.sm: Ua faaleaga foi e le tupu mea maualuluga sa i luma o Ierusalema i le itu taumatau o le mauga o le malaia, na faia e Solomona le tupu o Isaraelu mo Asaira le mea leaga a sa Saitonū, mo Kimosa foi le mea leaga a Moapi, mo Melekoma foi le mea leaga a le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.
verses.sm: Ua ia tufininii foi tupua, ma na vavae i lalo tupua o Asaira, ona faatutumu ai lea o mea sa latou i ai i ivi o tagata.

verses.en: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.
verses.sm: O le fata faitaulaga foi sa i Peteli, o le mea maualuga na faia e lele-. poamo le atalii o Nepata, o le na faatupu le agasala ia. Isaraelu, na ia lepeti i lea lava fata faitaulaga atoa ma le mea maualuga, ma na susunu le mea maualuga, ua tuūninii ai pei o le efuefu, ua na susunu foi le tupua o Asaira.

verses.en: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
verses.sm: Ona fāliu lea o Iosia, ua iloa atu ai tuugamau na i ai i 1-3 mauga, ua aauina atu ai nisi e au mai ivi ai tuugamau, ona susunu ai lea i luga o le fata faitaulaga, ua faaleaga ai, e tusa ma le afioga a Ieova na alaga mai ai e le tagata o le Atua, o le na alaga mai ia upu.

verses.en: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.
verses.sm: Ona fai afu ai lea, o ia, O le a lena faailoga ou te iloa atu ai ? Ona fai mai ai lea o tagata o le aai ia te ia, O le tuugamau lea o le tagata o le Atua na sau mai luta, ma alaga mai i na lava mea ua e faia i le fata faitaulaga i Peteli.

verses.en: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea q ia, Tuu pea ia te ia, aua nef oia Ō se tagata ona ivi. Qna sao ai na sau mai Samaria.

verses.en: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.
verses.sm: O fale uma foi o mea maualuluga sa i aai o Samaria, na faia e tupu o Isaraelu e faaonoono ia Ieova, ua aveeseina e Iosia, ua ia fai foi i ai faapei o mea uma na ia faia i Peteli.

verses.en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ua ia fasiotia le au ositaulaga o mea maualuluga sa i ai i luga o fata faitaulaga, ma na susunu ai ivi o tagata; ona foi atu ai lea o ia i lerusalema.

verses.en: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.
verses.sm: Ona poloai ai lea o le tupu i le nuu uma lava, ua faapea atu, Ia outou fai le paseka ia Ieova lo ©outou Atua, faapei ona tusia i le tusi o lenei feagaiga.

verses.en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
verses.sm: Auā e lei faia lava se paseka faapei o lenei talu i ona po o faamasino e na faamasino ia Isaraelu, atoa ma ona po uma o tupu o Isaraelu, ma tupu o Iuta;

verses.en: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.
verses.sm: na o le paseka lava lenei na faia ia Ieova i Ierusalema i le sefulu ma le valu o tausaga o le tupu o losia.

verses.en: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua aveeseina foi e Iosia e sa i ai aitu vavalo, ma taulāitu, ma faatagata, ma tupua, atoa ma mea inosia uma na iloa i le nuu o Iuta ma Ierusalema, ina ia faataunuuina e ia o upu o le tulafono na tusia i le tusi na maua e le ositaulaga o Hilikia i le fale o Ieova.

verses.en: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
verses.sm: E lei muamua ia te ia se tupu e tusa ma ia, o le na liliu atu ia Ieova ma lona loto atoa, ma lona agaga atoa, ma lona malosi atoa, e tusa ma le tulafono uma a Mose; talu ai foi e lei tu mai se tusa ma ia.

verses.en: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.
verses.sm: E ui lava i lea e lei liliueseina e ieova lona toasa matuā tele na ia toasa ai ia Iuta, ona o mea faaonoono uma na faaonoono ai Manase ia te ia.

verses.en: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
verses.sm: A ua faapea mai Ieova, Ou te ave ese ia luta foi i o‘u luma, faapei ona ou ave ese ia Isaraelu; ou te tiai foi le aai nei o Ierusalema na filifilia e a‘u, atoa foi ma le fale na ou fai atu ai, E i ai lo‘u igoa.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.sm: O toe o mea na faia e Iosia, ma mea uma na ia faia, e lei tusia ea ia mea i le tusi o tala i nofoaiga a tupu o Iuta ?

verses.en: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
verses.sm: O lana nofoaiga na alu ae ai Farao Neko le tupu o Aikupito i le vaitafe o Eufirate e sii ai le taua i le tupu o Asuria; ona alu atu ai lea o le tupu o losia e tau ma ia; ua la feiloai i Mekito, ona ia fasioti ai lea ia te ia.

verses.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.
verses.sm: Ua ave foi o ia ua oti, i le kariota e ana auauna ai Mekito, ua au mai ia te ia i Ierusalema, ma tanu ia te ia i lona tuugamau. Ona ave ai lea e tagata o le nuu ia Ioasasa le atalii o Iosia, ma faauu ia te ia ia fai o ia ma tupu, e sui a‘i lona tamā.

verses.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.sm: O le luafulu ma le tolu o ona tausaga na fai ai Ioasasa ma tupu, e tolu foi masina na ia tupu ai i Ierusalema. O le igoa o lona tinā o Hamutala, le afafine o leremia o le Lipena.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia le amio leaga i luma o ieova, pei o mea uma na faia e ona tamā.

verses.en: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
verses.sm: Ua noanoa e Farao Neko ia te ia i Ripelu i le nuu o Amato, ina ia le fai o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema; ua ia faasalaina foi le nuu o taleni ario e selau, ma le taleni auro.

verses.en: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.
verses.sm: Ua tofia e fai ma tupu e Farao Neko o Eliakimo le atalii o Iosia, e fai ma sui o lona tamā o Iosia, a ua liliu lona igoa ia Ioakima; ona ia ave ai lea o Ioasasa, ua oo foi o ia i Aikupito, ua oti ai.

verses.en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.
verses.sm: Ona avatu ai lea e Ioakima le ario ma le auro ia Farao, a ua na togitu taulaga a le nuu e avatu ai le ario, pei o le poloaiga a Farao, taitasi le tagata e tusa ma lana togiga, na ia faatauanau lava o ario ma auro ai tāgata o le nuu e avatu ai ia Farao Neko.

verses.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.sm: O le luafulu ma le lima o ona tausaga na fai ai Ioakima ma tupu ; e sefulu ma le tasi tausaga na tupu ai o ia i Ierusalema. O le igoa o lona tinā o Seputu o le afafine o Petaia o le Euma.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia foi le amio leaga i luma o Ieova, faāpei o mea uma na faia e ona tamā. 0 le faatoilaloina o Ioakima e Nepukanesa; ma le faatafeaina o le nuu.
